title: Set 173

sentences.ko: 아니야 아빠, 다 괜찮아. 차에서 좀 이상한 소리가 나긴 하는데 다음 주에 정비소에 맡길 거야. 그러니까 진짜 여기까지 차 몰고 내려올 필요 없어, 알았지?
sentences.text: No, everything's fine, Dad. The car's making kind of a weird noise, but I'm taking it in next week, so you really don't need to drive all the way down here, okay?

alts.text: Dad, I'm fine, seriously. Car's making a kinda weird noise, but it's going in next week, so you really don't gotta drive all the way down here, okay?
No, Dad, everything is fine. The car is making a somewhat unusual noise, but I am taking it to the mechanic next week, so there is truly no need for you to drive all the way down here.

sentences.note: **taking it in** 은 차를 정비소에 맡긴다는 뜻이에요. **all the way down here** 는 먼 길을 일부러 온다는 느낌을 살려 줘요.
sentences.situation: 부모님 안부 전화에서 잘 지낸다고 둘러대기

sentences.ko: 캠핑 가기로 했었는데 토요일 오전 내내 비가 쏟아져서 결국 처가에 갔어. 근데 솔직히 좀 좋더라, 아무도 나한테 뭘 하라고 안 해서.
sentences.text: We were supposed to go camping, but it poured all Saturday morning, so we ended up at my in-laws' instead, and honestly it was kind of nice, because nobody asked me to do anything.

alts.text: So camping was the plan, but it poured all Saturday morning, so we ended up at my in-laws' instead, and honestly? Kinda nice, since nobody asked me to do anything.

We had planned to go camping, but it rained heavily throughout Saturday morning, so we spent the day with my in-laws instead, and to be honest, it was rather pleasant, because no one asked me to do anything.

sentences.note: **were supposed to** 는 원래 하기로 했는데 틀어졌을 때 써요. **ended up** 은 계획과 달리 결국 그렇게 됐다는 말이고, **poured** 는 비가 쏟아졌다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 이 동네 진짜 좋은데 1월에 또 월세를 올린대. 그 돈을 낼 거면 차라리 세탁기 있는 집으로 가는 게 낫지. 근데 그러면 짐을 또 다 싸야 하잖아, 작년에 막 했는데.
sentences.text: I love this neighborhood, but they're raising the rent again in January, and if I'm going to pay that much, I might as well get a place with a washer. But then I'd have to pack everything up again, and I just did that last year.

alts.text: I love it here, but rent's going up again in January. If I'm paying that much, might as well get a place with a washer. But then I'd have to pack up all over again, and I literally just did that.

I am very fond of this neighborhood, but the rent is being raised again in January, and if I am going to pay that amount, I may as well find a place with a washing machine. However, I would then have to pack everything once more, and I did that only last year.

sentences.note: **might as well** 은 어차피 그럴 거면 차라리 ~하는 게 낫다는 뜻이에요. **pack everything up** 은 이사하려고 짐을 몽땅 싸는 것을 말해요.

sentences.ko: 이모네 집에 들어갔는데 코트를 벗기도 전에 다들 언제 결혼하냐, 회사는 왜 그만뒀냐 묻는 거야. 그래서 아무 대답도 안 하려고 그냥 계속 먹기만 했어.
sentences.text: I walked into my aunt's house and before I even took my coat off, everybody wanted to know when I'm getting married and why I quit my job. So I just kept eating so I wouldn't have to answer anything.

alts.text: So I walk into my aunt's place, haven't even got my coat off, and everybody's asking when I'm getting married and why I quit my job. I just kept eating so I wouldn't have to answer anything.

When I arrived at my aunt's house, before I had even removed my coat, everyone wanted to know when I would be getting married and why I had left my job. I simply continued eating so that I would not have to answer anything.

sentences.note: **before I even took my coat off** 는 ~하기도 전에 라는 느낌이에요. **so I wouldn't have to** 는 ~하지 않아도 되게, 즉 ~안 하려고 라는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

sentences.ko: 나 요즘 왜 이러는지 모르겠어. 하루 종일 피곤한데 침대에 눕기만 하면 정신이 말똥말똥해. 점심 먹고 나서는 커피도 끊었는데 하나도 소용이 없어.
sentences.text: I don't know what's going on with me. I'm exhausted all day, and then the second I get into bed I'm wide awake. I even stopped drinking coffee after lunch, and it hasn't helped at all.

alts.text: No idea what's up with me. I'm wiped all day, then the second I get into bed I'm wide awake. I even quit coffee after lunch, and it hasn't helped one bit.

I am not sure what is happening to me. I feel exhausted throughout the day, and yet the moment I get into bed, I am completely awake. I have even stopped drinking coffee after lunch, and it has not helped in the slightest.

sentences.note: **the second** 는 ~하자마자 라는 뜻이에요. **wide awake** 는 잠이 완전히 깬 상태, **hasn't helped at all** 은 전혀 도움이 안 됐다는 말이에요.

reviewed: 1번 casual 의 kinda a weird noise 는 원어민이 안 하는 말이라 a kinda weird noise 로 고침
1번 formal 의 Father 는 실제로 아빠를 부를 때 쓰지 않는 호칭이라 Dad 로 되돌림
3번 casual 이 text 와 거의 같아서 더 짧고 축약된 구어로 다시 씀
3번 formal 의 find a residence 는 말로 하기엔 너무 딱딱해서 find a place 로 고침
